parameters.content:
## Brighton · off the plan
The ingest service posts every deviation from the game plan that opens during a match to `POST /webhook/brighton/deviation` (with `X-Notify-Token`). Those whose priority is in `NOTIFY_PRIORITY` (default `high`: the plan's key instructions) are emailed to `STAFF_EMAIL_TO`, and posted to Slack and Telegram when those are set (the bench's phones), with a link that opens the deviation in the analysis room.

The code lives in `ai/config/n8n/src/`; settings are in `ai/.env`.

description: Tells the staff when a key target of the game plan goes off plan during a match.
